proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2712.1 kadala gives Prakrit kēla, Bengali kalā, Hindi kelā, Gujarati keḷ and Punjabi kellā “banana”. These survey l-bearing banana forms select the base branch, not the separately numbered retroflex kaḍalī. The exact regional route may include borrowing between Indo-Aryan languages; the supported family is linked under the user’s preference.
